newsitem.title: USA: Daschle doesn't see US budget, tax bill next week.
newsitem.headline: Daschle doesn't see US budget, tax bill next week.

text.p: Senate Democratic Leader Tom Daschle said Friday at the current rate of progress on crafting a compromise budget and tax bill it was unlikely they would be completed by next week as Republicans are hoping.
"At this rate I would say no," Daschle of South Dakota said at a press briefing. "I would say that it is unlikely to finish by the end of next week," he added.
"We're not going to see any movement unless the Republicans are prepared to give some," Daschle said.
"We gave a lot on the appropriations side; we expect them now to give on the tax side," he added.
